title: Kulbergs' claims about NGO costs are questionable
summary_full: Does each meeting between the government and Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) really cost 18,000 euros, as Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs claims? The Re:Check fact-checking strand investigates.
